CustomField.description: Booking value excluding VAT, including staff top-ups. Bookings needing a pricing check are excluded.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(NTE_Pricing_Ready__c), NULL, IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Amount)), Amount > 0), Amount, NTE_Listed_Price_Total__c) + BLANKVALUE(NTE_Top_Up_Staff_Total__c, 0))
CustomField.label: NTE Confirmed Value (ex VAT)
